ws = wb["Sheet1"]

ws_vals = wb_vals["Sheet1"]

def is_number(v):
    return isinstance(v, (int, float)) and not isinstance(v, bool)

# Excel AVERAGE semantics over B1:B10: ignore blanks/text/bools
b_values = [ws_vals[f"B{r}"].value for r in range(1, 11)]
numeric_b = [v for v in b_values if is_number(v)]
avg_b = sum(numeric_b) / len(numeric_b) if numeric_b else None

yellow_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFF00")

if avg_b is not None:
    cumulative = 0
    stop_row = None

    for r in range(1, 11):
        a_val = ws_vals[f"A{r}"].value
        if is_number(a_val):
            cumulative += a_val
        # Non-numeric A cells are treated as contributing 0 to the cumulative sum
        if cumulative >= avg_b:
            stop_row = r
            break

    if stop_row is not None:
        for r in range(1, stop_row + 1):
            ws[f"A{r}"].fill = yellow_fill

output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
